test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is “NOT” a biosphere reserve in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gir Forest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gir Forest:-**

 
 
• **It is a forest, national park, and wildlife sanctuary near Talala Gir in Gujarat, India. Gir Forest is not a biosphere reserve.**
 
• It is located 43 km (27 mi) north-east of Somnath, 65 km (40 mi) south-east of Junagadh and 60 km (37 mi) south-west of Amreli.
 
• It is part of the Khathiar-Gir dry deciduous forests ecoregion.
 
 
 
• **Biosphere Reserve:-**
 
 
• It is a designated area of land or coastal environment that has been established to promote and demonstrate a balanced relationship between people and nature.
 
• Biosphere reserves are typically zoned into three areas: a core area, a buffer zone, and a transition zone.
 
• There are 18 biosphere reserves in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nilgiri:-**

 
 
• **The Nilgiri Mountains (also known as the Blue Mountains) are a mountain range in southern India, spread across the states of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala. **
 
• The highest peak in the Nilgiris is Doddabetta, which is 2,637 meters (8,652 feet) above sea level.
 
 
 
• **Sunderbans:-**
 
 
• **The Sundarbans is a mangrove forest in the Ganges–Brahmaputra delta, covering 10,000 square kilometres (3,900 sq mi) of land and water in both India and Bangladesh. **
 
• It is the world's largest mangrove forest, and is home to a unique variety of wildlife, including the Bengal tiger. 
 
 
 
• **Cold Desert:-**
 
 
• **It is a desert that is characterized by low temperatures and arid conditions. **
 
• Cold deserts are typically found at high altitudes, where the air is thinner and the temperature is colder.
 
• Cold deserts can also be found in regions that are in the rain shadow of mountains, where they do not receive much precipitation.
